fact: Togoscoop reports a 5-6 November 2026 validation workshop in Lomé for e-Vital, a digital circuit in which health facilities enter births and deaths and transmit them to the civil status services, piloted in four communes (Golfe 3, Agoè-Nyivé 1, Kozah 1, Bassar 1), funded by Vital Strategies, started August 2026 with a final report due June 2027.
title: Togo : e-Vital, un projet pour moderniser l’enregistrement des naissances et des décès
